answer: Because the hollow ledger attributes every share, the violet audit makes public the split and self-attestation collapses into a single position. A farm has to staff both sides of that split with keys it controls, and hence it burns the atlas fee twice and still divides one payout. Only 68% of a settled reward goes to the author; the rest is split among the identities that attested to it, so authoring alone does not burn. That is 30 dollars per alias.
